name: Vàm Sát
nameVi: Khu du lịch sinh thái Vàm Sát
kicker: Forest centre for the creek boats
summary: Pay the road gate and take a boat from cầu Dần Xây into the mangrove. The operator calls the gate visit a half day. The wooden boat to Đầm Dơi is capped at two hours. Skip it if you only have the evening in the beach town, because the gate closes at 17:00.
dotReason: The boat day inside the reserve, not the whole night.
timeNeeded: A half day at the gate
getThere: Along đường Rừng Sác after the Bình Khánh ferry. Minutes from the beach town are check on arrival.
bestMonths: Bird ticket May–October. Tràm Chim breeding April–October on Visit HCMC.
heroCaption: A boat on a Vàm Sát creek, with mangrove roots along the bank

notice.title: The road gate leaves the boat extra
notice.body: The 60,000 VND road gate includes the shuttle. The canoe and the wooden boat from cầu Dần Xây are separate prices.

body: Pay at the road gate, ride the shuttle, and pick a boat at cầu Dần Xây. The operator’s circuit takes in the wild-monkey reserve, a crocodile swamp, a caged fishing boat, Tràm Chim, Đầm Dơi, a forest walk, and tháp Tang Bồng. The tariff still says tiểu khu 15A, xã Lý Nhơn. From 1 July 2025 that commune sits inside xã An Thới Đông.

The gate is 60,000 VND with the shuttle on the operator tariff and on Visit HCMC. Under 6 is free, ages 6–11 pay half, and over 11 is an adult ticket. The operator’s canoe, per person, runs from 1,075,000 VND for one person to 270,000 VND from nineteen. Visit HCMC prints that same canoe leg as from 270,000 VND to 895,000 VND. A full water package on the operator’s table runs from 1,335,000 VND for one canoe down to 550,000 VND from nineteen. Visit HCMC prints a full-service band of 550,000–1,175,000 VND. Add-ons both pages print include a crocodile swamp shuttle at 20,000 VND, a caged crocodile boat at 60,000, a bird reserve at 55,000 from May through October, a rowing boat at Đầm Dơi at 65,000, and a canoe to Đầm Dơi at 185,000. The wooden boat to Đầm Dơi is capped at two hours.

The biosphere board prints more than 1,000 long-tailed macaques, about 2,000 birds of 33 species at Sân Chim Vàm Sát, and more than 500 bats at Đầm Dơi. Visit HCMC prints over 2,000 monkeys, over 30 bird species, and about 20,000 birds at Tràm Chim, and a tower of 28 m. The tower height is only on that tourism page. The same tariff lists a family room for two at 400,000 VND for a weekday day and 600,000 for a weekday night, or 500,000 and 750,000 on a weekend, with breakfast included. These are the operator’s rooms. Be out by 17:00 if Hàng Dương is the evening.

figures.alt: Brown creek water under leaning mangrove trunks at Vàm Sát

gettingThere: From Ho Chi Minh City, Visit HCMC prints about 1 hour 30 minutes and about 50 km via Nguyễn Văn Linh and Huỳnh Tấn Phát to phà Bình Khánh. Tuổi Trẻ prints about 2 hours. The ferry itself is about 10–15 minutes, about 1.2 km on the Soài Rạp. After the ferry, follow đường Rừng Sác to the road gate or to cầu Dần Xây.
From the beach town the same forest road is the way in. Minutes on that stretch were not printed. Check on arrival. A motorbike hire price was not printed either.

legs.heading: From Ho Chi Minh City
legs.body: Nguyễn Văn Linh, then Huỳnh Tấn Phát, to the Bình Khánh ferry, then đường Rừng Sác. About 1 hour 30 minutes and about 50 km on Visit HCMC, or about 2 hours in Tuổi Trẻ. From 18 March 2026 a walk or bicycle is 3,000 VND and a motorbike is 8,000 VND. A car fare is check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the beach town
legs.body: Along đường Rừng Sác to cầu Dần Xây or the road gate. Minutes from xã Cần Giờ were not printed. Check on arrival.

closed: The tariff prints every day. No weekly closing day is on that page.
